verdict.rationale: Granola ships a public REST API, so a sandbox story is a fair question for it. Its own API FAQ answers the sandbox question with "Not currently" and suggests a dedicated test folder, which is a user-side workaround rather than isolation. The interactive playground also sends live requests to the production API, so it is not a sandbox either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
